settings.text: We are not a label. We are a cult with a screen printer. moonbae is raw art from artists who never asked to be liked, worn by people who do not need to be. Everything here is made in India, one piece at a time, after someone asks for it.

settings.center: Raw art for the crazy ones

settings.text: We do not chase trends and we do not do clean. The art is scanned straight off the page, scratches and all, and printed in India once someone asks for it. Small runs. No stock. Every piece exists because one person wanted it to.

settings.copyright: moonbae ©2026 _ made after dark _ all rights reserved

settings.title: Raw, on purpose
settings.text: The art goes on the shirt the way it came off the page. No smoothing, no committee. If the line shakes, the line shakes.

settings.title: Made after dark
settings.text: Most of this was drawn at night by people who should have been asleep. That energy is the whole point.

settings.title: One at a time
settings.text: Printed in India after you order. Nothing sits in a warehouse waiting to be discounted. Each piece exists because you asked for it.

settings.title: For the crazy ones
settings.text: Artists, misfits, the kid drawing on the back of the exam paper. If you have ever been told to tone it down, this is for you.

settings.giving_text: No seasons, no trends, no permission. We drop when the art is ready and not before. Artists get credited and paid. You get something nobody else at the party is wearing.

settings.question: How long till it lands?
settings.answer: Nothing exists until you order it — printing takes 2–4 business days. Delivery inside India is then 3–7 business days to metro cities and up to 12 for other pin codes, so usually 5–11 business days door to door. A tracking link hits your email the moment it ships.

settings.question: Can I return or swap it?
settings.answer: Every piece is made for one person — you — so we cannot take returns for change of mind or fit. Check the size guide first, and ask us if you are between sizes. If it arrives damaged, misprinted or wrong, we replace or refund it, free. Write to us within 5 days of delivery.

settings.question: Why the unboxing video?
settings.answer: One continuous, unedited take from sealed parcel to item out. Ten seconds. It is the only proof a fault did not happen after delivery — without it our printers will not accept a claim, so neither can we.

settings.question: Can I cancel?
settings.answer: Yes — within 1 hour of ordering. Production starts almost immediately, so the window is short. Email us the moment you know. After that the piece exists only for you and cannot be cancelled.

settings.question: How do the sizes run?
settings.answer: Tees run oversized — size down for a closer fit. Everything is hand-cut and can vary by up to ±0.5 inch from the size guide. That is normal for apparel, not a fault.

settings.question: How do I keep the art alive?
settings.answer: Cold wash, inside out, gentle cycle. No bleach. Hang to dry or tumble low. Never iron straight over the print. Treat it right and it softens with every wash and lasts for years.

settings.question: Where is it made?
settings.answer: India. Cut, printed and finished in small runs, close to the people who make it. Nothing is made in bulk or warehoused — each piece is made once someone asks for it.
